evals.prompt: Test mail search engine with boundary conditions: empty query, whitespace query, empty message array, partial word match, and date range filtering with same-day, reversed, and empty ranges
evals.expected_output: All boundary conditions handled correctly: empty/whitespace queries return full list, empty arrays return empty, partial matches work, reversed date ranges return empty

expectations.name: whitespace-query-returns-all
expectations.assertion: searchMessages with whitespace-only query returns all messages

expectations.name: reversed-date-range-empty
expectations.assertion: filterByDateRange with from > to returns empty array

expectations.name: same-day-range-inclusive
expectations.assertion: filterByDateRange with same-day boundaries includes messages on that day

evals.prompt: Test mail threading engine resolution priority: In-Reply-To header > References (last first) > subject matching. Verify cross-account isolation and empty input handling
evals.expected_output: Thread resolution follows RFC 5322 priority correctly, last Reference wins over earlier ones, different accounts don't share threads

expectations.name: last-reference-wins
expectations.assertion: resolveThread picks the last Reference header match over earlier ones

expectations.name: cross-account-isolation
expectations.assertion: resolveThread returns null when only match is in a different account

expectations.name: empty-thread-metadata
expectations.assertion: buildThreadMetadata with empty messages returns 0 counts and empty participants

evals.prompt: Test mail filter engine with priority ordering, inactive filter skipping, unknown field handling, and first-match-wins semantics
evals.expected_output: Filters process in priority order, inactive filters skipped, unknown fields return false, first match stops processing

expectations.name: first-match-wins
expectations.assertion: applyFilters returns first matching filter by priority, ignoring subsequent matches

expectations.name: unknown-field-safe
expectations.assertion: matchesFilter with unknown field returns false instead of throwing

expectations.name: all-inactive-no-match
expectations.assertion: applyFilters with all inactive filters returns matched: false

evals.prompt: Test mail encryption engine with expired keys, revoked keys, own-key filtering, empty recipients, and partial key coverage reporting
evals.expected_output: Expired and revoked keys are excluded, own keys are not returned for contact lookup, empty recipients can always encrypt, missing keys are listed

expectations.name: expired-key-excluded
expectations.assertion: findKeyForContact returns null for keys with expiresAt in the past

expectations.name: empty-recipients-can-encrypt
expectations.assertion: canEncrypt with empty recipients array returns canEncrypt: true

expectations.name: partial-coverage-lists-missing
expectations.assertion: canEncrypt with some missing keys returns the specific missing emails

evals.prompt: Test mail calendar engine with multi-event ICS parsing, attendee extraction, missing DTEND default, and all RSVP statuses (accepted, declined, tentative)
evals.expected_output: Multiple VEVENT blocks parsed separately, attendees extracted from mailto: lines, missing DTEND defaults to +1 hour, all RSVP statuses generate correct PARTSTAT

expectations.name: multi-event-parsing
expectations.assertion: parseIcs with 2 VEVENT blocks returns 2 ParsedEvent objects

expectations.name: missing-dtend-default
expectations.assertion: Event without DTEND gets dtend = dtstart + 1 hour

expectations.name: rsvp-declined-partstat
expectations.assertion: generateRsvpReply with declined status contains PARTSTAT=DECLINED
